experiment.high_level_search: beam search over selector-supported learned options as macro-actions
experiment.macro_rollout: deterministic option-policy primitive actions in recurrent child-owned planning latent until learned termination or max_option_steps
experiment.primitive_control: active option action policy; unrestricted primitive beam search disabled
experiment.score: imagined discounted reward + selector-supported option-policy terminal action value
experiment.selector_logit_usage: candidate filtering and exact-score tie-break only; no weighted score blend
